Stopped in and spoke with Tony, who oversees four locations for this group. Tony shared that they have a new manager at this location who has been doing significantly more financing over the past two months than the stores have historically seen.

Tony was not aware of this requirement. After explaining it, he said it would not be an issue going forward and that he would make sure the process is implemented across all four of his locations.

We also reinforced the importance of **in-person verification and ensuring all transactions are completed in person**.

Subject: 00TTO000012IPUc2AO
Full Comments:
Spoke with Paul, the owner. He shared that he has been in the industry for 27 years and described the current slowdown as highly unusual, noting that he has been with KBC/Midas for many years and has not seen business this slow. He stated that stores across his division, spanning the lower LA area through Las Vegas, are down approximately 34% overall. He noted that the Encinitas Midas location and one or two other stores are performing more sustainably, but the majority of the division is experiencing the same decline.

Paul’s phone was ringing throughout the call, so our conversation was brief. I attempted to gather additional shop potential beyond car counts, but he was limited on time. I thanked him for his time and will revisit volume, repair order potential, and opportunities to increase EasyPay utilization on the next call. This conversation also provided helpful insight into Midas’ divisional structure and broader market performance.
